response: John Lahart, the Fianna Fáil TD for Dublin South-West, is rightly calling for reform of the inheritance tax exemption thresholds, describing the current system as ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children. This comes after similar pushes from other party colleagues to review how the tax hits different family structures. This really exposes the systemic discrimination baked into our institutions, where policies have long favored traditional family models and reinforced historical inequalities that disadvantage vulnerable groups who don't have children. Real institutional reform is needed to dismantle these biases and advance social justice and equality for everyone.
